title: Focus on Value
coreMove: Focus on Value is visible when pressure changes priorities: protect outcomes, benefits, and the business case before defending activity, deliverable volume, or a stale baseline.

exampleSpecs.domain: project recovery meeting after a status review
exampleSpecs.audience: project leads who can recite principles but need to use one
exampleSpecs.stakes: the team can either protect expected outcomes or celebrate work that no longer pays off
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Two people use the PMI 12 principles and Focus on Value language to test whether benefits and outcomes still guide the decision.

exampleSpecs.domain: compressed software release with adoption work removed
exampleSpecs.audience: teams tempted to treat date recovery as value recovery
exampleSpecs.stakes: schedule pressure can create a clean baseline while weakening the business case
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: The setup implies the saved schedule is the success, then reveals the tradeoff damaged the expected benefit.

exampleSpecs.domain: short team chat during schedule compression
exampleSpecs.audience: project managers making small cuts through informal channels
exampleSpecs.stakes: an informal cut can defend the baseline while weakening the benefit path
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: A compressed chat shows schedule pressure, baseline defense, business case, and tradeoff logic without a formal meeting.

exampleSpecs.domain: daily standup that has become a task-completion recital
exampleSpecs.audience: delivery leads who need a practical pause when activity crowds out outcomes
exampleSpecs.stakes: a routine can reward volume unless someone restarts it around value evidence
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: A routine is interrupted and deliberately restarted around outcomes, benefits, and evidence.

exampleSpecs.domain: quiet project room after a governance review
exampleSpecs.audience: readers learning to see value signals in small details
exampleSpecs.stakes: visible completion can crowd out quieter evidence of benefits and outcomes
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: A small observed desk scene contrasts green output stickers with PMI Focus on Value, 12 principles, benefits, and outcomes.

exampleSpecs.domain: launch postmortem after an on-time deployment misses benefit targets
exampleSpecs.audience: teams reconstructing how value was lost after a schedule win
exampleSpecs.stakes: the review can blame execution noise or locate the one tradeoff that broke value
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: The scene opens after failure and reconstructs how schedule pressure, baseline defense, business case, and tradeoff evidence point to one decisive misstep.
